**Li(p)-service? An algorithm for computing p-adic polylogarithms**

*Article electronically published on November 5, 2007*

30 pp, 11 sections.

**Abstract.** We describe an algorithm for computing Coleman’s p-adic poly- logarithms up to a given precision.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 The p-adic polylogarithm; Acknowledgments; 3 Method of computation on U0 and U; 4 Method of computation in the generic case; 5 Method of computation on U1; 6 Estimates; 7 The algorithm; 8 Concluding remarks; References
